name: Sample Return Capsule
about: Sample Return Capsule (1999-003D, JPL), launched 1999 Feb  7. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Earth, 81P/Wild 2, UTTR. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.
